description:
Keyword research, each with volume, difficulty, CPC, intent, Opportunity (0 to 100), fit (0 to 3), onTopic and saved. One keyword search per call (the same within 30 days is free). Save the good ones with update_keywords.
from:
- seed(query, limit?, months?): Ideas around a seed search.
- competitor(domain, limit?, months?): The searches a site ranks for (any domain, the top 200), with its position.
- gap(domain, limit?, months?): Searches a rival ranks for and the site doesn't.
name: research_keywords
title: Research keywords
